scope.requirement_transcribed: apply each venue's VIP-0 fees, funding at 1h/8h, without double counting spread, expecting a positive net return at 2.0x fees, with <1 bps independent event-driven ledger parity
scope.prior_cost_basis: a flat 6.0 bps per unit of turnover on taker grids and 8.90 bps calibrated pair-turn midpoint on H3_MAKER; each reconciliation block proves exact reproduction

venue_fees.source: audit section 14.1, VIP-0 fee table, October-November 2026
venue_fees.side: taker for H1/H2/H3/H1_G1/H2_G1; calibrated FIFO maker+adverse-selection+leg-miss for H3_MAKER
venue_fees.side_note: uncalibrated raw maker fills remain refused in fees.per_side_bps(..., side='maker'); H3_MAKER uses explicit FIFO partial fill (p_fill<1), adverse selection (1.5-3.0 bps), and forced emergency taker fallback (p_leg_miss=0.15-0.25)

spread_band.method: Corwin-Schultz on per-symbol 4-hour bars, median of per-bar estimates, sign kept; 4-hour bars rather than daily because a daily high-low range is dominated by the day's trend rather than by the quoted spread
spread_band.caveat: A high-low estimator measures the range the price covered, and only part of that range is the bid-ask. For a liquid pair the true quoted spread is a few bps, while this estimator reads tens of bps on the same bars, so the estimate is an upper bound rather than a calibration. It is used as the top of a band whose floor is the audit's own liquid-pair half-spread anchor; the band's width is reported rather than hidden behind a single point estimate.

cost_model.no_double_counting: OHLCV close-price branch binds: for taker orders, half-spread, latency slippage, and volatility impact are added once; for H3_MAKER passive fills, half-spread is NOT charged on passive fills (which pay adverse_selection_bps instead) and only the p_leg_miss forced-taker fallback crosses half-spread

empirical_l1_and_impact_quotes.data_nature: point_in_time_empirical_top_of_book_snapshot (l2Book + metaAndAssetCtxs impactPxs); NOT historical L2 tick replay — historical 1h series is fundingHistory below
empirical_l1_and_impact_quotes.no_double_counting_note: When pricing close-price books at Hyperliquid's empirical impactPxs half-spread, impact_half_spread_bps replaces the 3.0 bps floor once and is never added twice.
